channel.title: Wisconsin Newspaper Association - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Wisconsin Newspaper Association (wnanews.com)

item.title: Opees highlight good works, and bad
item.description: In advance of national Sunshine Week (sunshineweek.org), March 15-21, the Wisconsin Freedom of Information Council has named the winners of its 20th annual Openness in Government Awards, or Opees.

item.title: Wisconsin Freedom of Information Council names ‘Opee’ winners
item.description: Two attempts to peel back the veil of secrecy over the proliferation of data centers are being honored in this year’s Openness in Government Awards, or Opees, bestowed by the Wisconsin Freedom of Information Council.

item.title: Runberg writes final column for Free Press
item.description: Editor Justin Runberg published his final column in the March 3, 2026 issue of the Amery Free Press.

item.title: Gruich fires attorney in case that included threat against Wisconsin newspaper publisher
item.description: A Michigan man accused of threatening an Oneida County judge and newspaper publisher Gregg Walker has dismissed his attorney and retained new legal counsel, prompting the court to postpone his upcoming jury trial and schedule a new trial date.

item.title: Journalist, columnist Dave Begel dies at age 82
item.description: Longtime journalist, columnist and commentator Dave Begel died on March 3, 2026 at age 82.

item.title: Poling’s Birkie book wins award
item.description: Former Eau Claire Leader-Telegram journalist Jerry Poling’s book, “American Birkebeiner: The Nation’s Greatest Ski Marathon,” has won a ULLR award.

item.title: The Document Divide: Why public record laws are failing average Americans, and what to do about it
item.description: Freedom of information should be freedom of information for all. It is not.

item.title: Cleared for construction: Development approval and permitting in metro Milwaukee
item.description: Building projects in metro Milwaukee are approved more quickly in cities that allow development to move through a streamlined review process so long as it meets appropriate standards for its proposed location.

item.title: Pamela Henson joins Adams MultiMedia as president and publisher of Southern Wisconsin Group
item.description: Adams MultiMedia announced on March 12, 2026 that Pamela Henson, a longtime media executive, will be regional president and publisher of Southern Wisconsin Group.

item.title: Watertown no longer allowing public attendance on Zoom meetings
item.description: The City of Watertown has stopped allowing public attendance on Zoom meetings after several instances of “Zoom bombings” filled with graphic sexual images, or profane and hateful language.
